review_scope: Retained 18-test output plus complete six newly added integration tests, previous twelve reviewed earlier; benchmark.py measurement and assertions reviewed. No second execution.
measurement_limits: One sample per size; no percentile or whole-app memory conclusion.
RSS sums only sidecar process group, not physical footprint/desktop/WebView.
durationMs includes requested 20ms sampling sleep and ps overhead.
Cancel case starts timing before launch, sends SIGTERM after approximately 350ms, then records whole request duration 412.82ms; exact cancellation latency is not measured.
Before sample does not retain prior binary hash; conditions/load are not matched sufficiently for a causal or stable speedup claim.
